description: Follow-up regression reported by user: opaque absolute accent hover layers cover channel card descriptions in light and dark themes. Scope: remove decorative full-card overlays from channel hub/provider cards and equivalent email navigation cards; preserve DS card hover borders, links, IDs and events. Action reuse: not applicable, presentation-only. Reproduce in real browser before applying; add a focused existing-channel UI regression check without changing existing assertions or authoring a new feature journey. Validate hover in both themes, focused LiveView/components and existing channel E2E, mix q and final mix precommit. Update screenshots and Beadwork. No commit/push.

comments.text: Reproduced before fixing: new focused Chromium regression fails in both light and dark modes because the hovered retrieval category description is covered. Root cause: I changed the original low-alpha decorative gradient into an opaque accent surface on an absolute full-card layer. Positioned header content remained visible, while the unpositioned description painted underneath. Removed those layers from the three hub/provider template positions and the equivalent email navigation card; preserve the existing DS card hover border/shadow and all links/events. No existing assertions changed.

title: [zaq-twk.4] Fix card hover overlays obscuring text
